title: Maximum garage and carport parking for an ancillary dwelling, R50 and above, outside Perth and Peel (as printed: 0)
text: Table 2.3b (occupant car parking): Ancillary dwelling - maximum garage and carport parking for R50 and above (per dwelling) 0.

replaces.note: Part C maximum for ancillary was 1

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Content twin of Chapter 2 C2.3.3-r3 (renumbered). Same Table 2.3b header problem as C2.3.5-r2: read literally an ancillary dwelling at R50+ outside Perth and Peel may have no garage or carport space, contradicting the ancillary minimum of 1 at R40 and below. Encoded as printed.

verified.note: Page 20 prints Table 2.3b with columns headed 'Minimum parking space(s) for R40 and below (per dwelling)' (1 / 1 / 2 / 2) and 'Maximum garage and carport parking for R50 and above (per dwelling)' (0 / 1 / 1 / 1) for ancillary / studio-1 bed / 2 bed / 3+ bed. The headings are not transposed; the second column reads like minimums under a 'maximum' heading and caps a 3+ bedroom dwelling below the R40-and-below minimum. Encoded as printed.
